stepNotes.1: The context unit combines checkout analysis, pure AGENTS.md generation, guarded file lifecycle operations, and a four-tier long-agent prompt packer used by session code.
stepNotes.2: Checkout-controlled manifest and path text crosses into generated Markdown or provider context, while the sole file mutation is root/AGENTS.md and packed content is not logged.
stepNotes.3: Most precedence and I/O behavior is explicit, but separator characters are excluded during admission and can make the rendered token estimate exceed the requested budget.
stepNotes.4: Analysis caps scans at 5,000 files in batches of 50; generation is list-bounded, and packing performs two bounded whole-context joins in the prompt path.
stepNotes.5: Analyzer, renderer, lifecycle wrapper, and packer have distinct ownership; the private public-parameter type and duplicated convention package-manager field are API rough edges.
stepNotes.6: No marker or suppression debt was found; broad manifest error suppression reduces diagnostics, and strict-mode guidance is unreachable through analyzer-produced data.
stepNotes.7: Twenty-five focused tests cover decoding, selected generated sections, and tier behavior, but omit Context I/O, analyzer integration, most generator modes, and separator-aware budget enforcement.
stepNotes.8: The ledger is empty; this pass records one Low budget-accounting defect, keeps two lesser quality observations, and finds no Critical item requiring re-verification.
stepNotes.9: All three focused test files passed, core typechecking passed, and a two-entry runtime probe reproduced a 2-token result under a 1-token budget.
